name: MACDTool
description: MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) - measures momentum and trend strength by comparing two EMAs. Signal line crossovers indicate potential buy/sell opportunities.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: Fast EMA Period
fields.description: Period for fast EMA. CHOOSE based on sensitivity: 8-10 for aggressive/volatile stocks, 12 for standard, 15-20 for smoother signals on stable stocks.

fields.label: Slow EMA Period
fields.description: Period for slow EMA. Must be greater than fast period. CHOOSE: 20-26 for standard, 30-40 for long-term trend confirmation.

fields.label: Signal Line EMA
fields.description: Period for signal line. CHOOSE: 7-9 for faster crossover signals, 12-14 for fewer but more reliable signals.
